exercises.q: Он вспомнил про ___ (своя встреча, acc. sg.) в суде, нахмурился и покраснел.
exercises.why: **встреча → встречу** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  **свой → свою** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with встречу). A possessive — declines like DLI's мой. Ending -я → -ю.  Declension: sg. встреча · встречи · встрече · встречу · встречей · встрече; pl. встречи · встреч · встречам · встречи · встречами · встречах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «Notice the similarity of the endings of the possessives to the form of «они».» мой · моё — моего — моему — моим — о моём; моя — моей — мою; мои — моих — моим — моими — о моих. — DLI, Lessons 47–48.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

Declension: sg. зелень · зелени · зелени · зелень · зеленью · зелени; pl. зелени · зеленей · зеленям · зелени · зеленями · зеленях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: И сквозь ___ (стеклянная дверь, acc. sg.): все в комнате рассыпано, перевернуто, скомкано.
exercises.why: **дверь → дверь** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -ь. Declines like DLI's часть — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. часть). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **стеклянный → стеклянную** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with дверь). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. новую. Ending -ая → -ую.  Declension: sg. дверь · двери · двери · дверь · дверью · двери; pl. двери · дверей · дверям · двери · дверями · дверях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: И про ___ (француз, acc. pl.) шли такие же рассказы.
exercises.why: **француз → французов** (acc. pl.). Masculine, animate; nominative plural французы. Declines like DLI's студент — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. студентов). exercises.q: Про ___ (старый, acc. pl.) дрожжи не поминать двожды, то дело прошло...
exercises.why: **старый → старые** (acc. pl., agreeing with дрожжи). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension of старый (plural): старые · старых · старым · старые (inan.) / старых (anim.) · старыми · старых.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
